brief: A comprehensive and futuristic spaceship control panel dominates the canvas, featuring a complex arrangement of physical-looking buttons, switches, and analog gauges. The panel is anchored by a central windscreen display. The control elements are finished in metallic grays and blacks, contrasted by the glowing indicator lights. All inactive switches emit a steady, vibrant cyan glow, which gives the panel a distinctive, electric color palette. When the user clicks a specific button, the entire setup remains stable, but the windscreen display dynamically transitions, showing the ship initiating and entering hyperspace with streaks of brilliant color and rapid, smooth movement.
